What we build

Three ways we take work off your team.

AI automation

Agents that handle customer enquiries and follow-ups, documents, onboarding, reporting and internal assistants.

Websites and platforms

Business websites, online stores, booking systems, portals, web apps, SaaS products and marketplaces.

Integrations and payments

API, CRM and WhatsApp connections, payment checkout and payouts, and stablecoin payments through licensed providers.

Each is a project of its own, with a clear scope and price. We can add an agent to any of them.

How we work

The same five steps on every project.

1

Understand. We map how the work happens today and what it costs you.

2

Design. A plain plan with a fixed scope and price.

3

Build. Small pieces, tested on real cases.

4

Review. A technical check of security and permissions before launch.

5

Launch and improve. We train your team, then monitor and improve.

Monthly care plans cover monitoring, fixes and improvements after launch, with a monthly results report.
